COUI local source baseline for ONextBox
======================================

Upstream: https://github.com/suqi8/coui
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE and the original notices in source files)

The sources come from the published Android sources JARs for the exact COUI
versions used by ONextBox at commit e193b64fa603691fdea448786d15b0c810effa5a:

  1.1.0: coui-core, coui-shader, coui-squircle, coui-ui, coui-preference, coui-icons
  1.0.0: coui-blur, coui-navigation3-ui

The previous dependency graph already selected shader/squircle 1.1.0 when blur
and navigation3-ui requested 1.0.0. The local graph preserves that selection.
sources.json records the source URLs, SHA-256 digests, published AAR digests,
and Kotlin file counts. sources.sha256 records the imported source baseline.
It is an audit record, not a requirement to leave these sources immutable.

Import changes:
- Android and common Kotlin sources are retained; other platform targets and
  upstream publication, documentation and example build plugins are omitted.
- CRCRLF/CRLF line endings are normalized to LF. Kotlin logic is unchanged.
- Five baseline profiles are retained from the corresponding published AARs.
- Build scripts use the project's Kotlin/AGP/Compose compiler and local project
  dependencies. Non-COUI dependencies retain their previous declared versions.
  Local Android compilation is aligned with the app Compose BOM and the
  Lifecycle 2.11.0 version already selected by the original app runtime graph.
- No upstream binary JAR/AAR is required to compile these COUI modules.
- The full license and this provenance record are included in the app assets.

ONextBox UI standard:
The app's ui/common, ui/layout, ui/settings and Root implementations at the
baseline commit define the accepted appearance and interaction. Keep their
theme, spacing, joined cards, expansion motion, navigation materials and
startup behavior when maintaining the bundled components. Upstream changes
are reviewed and selected manually rather than applied automatically.

Maintenance:
- Edit the local modules directly when a component fix is needed.
- Preserve upstream license/copyright notices and record imported changes here.
- Do not replace project dependencies with remote COUI coordinates or a Git
  submodule. :app:verifyLocalCoui inspects all app runtime variants and also
  runs automatically before app builds and as part of :app:check.
- AndroidX, Compose, Kotlin, AGP and other non-COUI dependencies still use the
  normal dependency repositories; this is not a fully offline Android SDK.
